ignoreCommand: if [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ]; then if git cat-file -e "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then git diff --quiet "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" HEAD -- .; else exit 1; fi; elif git rev-parse -q --verify "HEAD^" >/dev/null; then git diff --quiet HEAD^ HEAD -- .; else exit 1; fi
